title: Amazon to start selling cars in the UK next year
summary: US retail giant links up with Hyundai in attempt to crack £200bn British market

blocks.text:
US retail giant links up with Hyundai in attempt to crack £200bn British market

  • Business live – latest updates

Amazon is planning to sell cars in the UK from early next year, in a move that threatens to disrupt the vehicle retail market.

The Amazon Autos service will be launched in “early 2027”, starting with cars from Korean manufacturer Hyundai. It will be the first time the US tech company has sold cars outside its home country.
